Higher‑Dimensional Brane Interactions

Collisions, Cycles, and Cosmology

In string/M‑theory, branes are multidimensional objects. Our universe could be a 3‑brane in a higher‑D bulk. Branes can move, collide, and separate. Collisions release vast energy, manifesting as a hot Big Bang. This underlies ekpyrotic and cyclic cosmologies where each collision seeds a new cycle.
